title: Hades
description: A roguelike dungeon crawler in which the prince of the Underworld fights his way out of his father's realm, one escape attempt at a time.

title: Hollow Knight
description: A hand-drawn action adventure through Hallownest, a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes.

title: Elden Ring
description: An open-world action RPG set in the Lands Between, where the Tarnished seek to become Elden Lord.

title: Stardew Valley
description: Inherit your grandfather's old farm plot and build a new life growing crops, raising animals and befriending the town.

title: Halo Infinite
description: The Master Chief returns to face the Banished on the fractured ringworld Zeta Halo.

title: Celeste
description: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain in this tight, hand-crafted platformer.

title: Disco Elysium
description: A detective RPG with a unique skill system and a whole city block to carve your path across.

title: God of War
description: Kratos, living as a man in the realm of Norse gods and monsters, must fight to survive and teach his son to do the same.

title: Portal 2
description: A first-person puzzle game of portals, test chambers and a very patient AI, playable alone or in co-op.

title: Forza Horizon 5
description: An open-world racing game set across the landscapes of Mexico, with hundreds of cars to drive.

title: Outer Wilds
description: An open-world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: Monster hunter Geralt of Rivia searches a war-torn open world for the child of prophecy.
